comment:
* A formatter which formats phone numbers as they are entered. * *

An AsYouTypeFormatter can be created by invoking * {@link PhoneNumberUtil#getAsYouTypeFormatter}. After that, digits can be added by invoking * {@link #inputDigit} on the formatter instance, and the partially formatted phone number will be * returned each time a digit is added. {@link #clear} can be invoked before formatting a new * number. * *

See the unittests for more details on how the formatter is to be used. * * @author Shaopeng Jia

variables.name: currentFormattingPattern
variables.comment: The pattern from numberFormat that is currently used to create formattingTemplate.

variables.name: ableToFormat
variables.comment: This indicates whether AsYouTypeFormatter is currently doing the formatting.

variables.name: inputHasFormatting
variables.comment: all when this is set to true.

variables.name: isCompleteNumber
variables.comment: true, we will no longer use local number formatting patterns.

variables.name: ELIGIBLE_FORMAT_PATTERN
variables.comment: no data is lost while formatting; when we format as you type, this should always be the case.

variables.name: NATIONAL_PREFIX_SEPARATORS_PATTERN
variables.comment: us that we should separate the national prefix from the number when formatting.

variables.name: MIN_LEADING_DIGITS_LENGTH
variables.comment: regular expression that matches up to this number of digits.

variables.name: originalPosition
variables.comment: found in the original sequence of characters the user entered.

variables.name: regexCache
variables.comment: A cache for frequently used country-specific regular expressions.

methods.name: private PhoneMetadata getMetadataForRegion(String regionCode)
methods.comment: code. Therefore, we return the metadata for "main" region for this country calling code.

methods.name: private boolean maybeCreateNewTemplate()
methods.comment: Returns true if a new template is created as opposed to reusing the existing template.

methods.comment: digits are added one by one.

methods.name: public void clear()
methods.comment: * Clears the internal state of the formatter, so it can be reused.

methods.name: public String inputDigit(char nextChar)
methods.comment:
* Formats a phone number on-the-fly as each digit is entered.
   *
   * @param nextChar  the most recently entered digit of a phone number. Formatting characters are
   *     allowed, but as soon as they are encountered this method formats the number as entered and
   *     not "as you type" anymore. Full width digits and Arabic-indic digits are allowed, and will
   *     be shown as they are.
   * @return  the partially formatted phone number.

methods.name: public String inputDigitAndRememberPosition(char nextChar)
methods.comment:
* Same as {@link #inputDigit}, but remembers the position where {@code nextChar} is inserted, so
   * that it can be retrieved later by using {@link #getRememberedPosition}. The remembered
   * position will be automatically adjusted if additional formatting characters are later
   * inserted/removed in front of {@code nextChar}.

methods.name: private boolean ableToExtractLongerNdd()
methods.comment: in a number we can format, we try to see if we can extract a longer version here.

methods.name: String attemptToFormatAccruedDigits()
methods.comment:
* Checks to see if there is an exact pattern match for these digits. If so, we should use this
   * instead of any other formatting template whose leadingDigitsPattern also matches the input.

methods.name: public int getRememberedPosition()
methods.comment:
* Returns the current position in the partially formatted phone number of the character which was
   * previously passed in as the parameter of {@link #inputDigitAndRememberPosition}.

methods.name: private String appendNationalNumber(String nationalNumber)
methods.comment:
* Combines the national number with any prefix (IDD/+ and country code or national prefix) that
   * was collected. A space will be inserted between them if the current formatting template
   * indicates this to be suitable.

methods.name: private String attemptToChooseFormattingPattern()
methods.comment:
* Attempts to set the formatting template and returns a string which contains the formatted
   * version of the digits entered so far.

methods.name: private String inputAccruedNationalNumber()
methods.comment:
* Invokes inputDigitHelper on each digit of the national number accrued, and returns a formatted
   * string in the end.

methods.name: private boolean isNanpaNumberWithNationalPrefix()
methods.comment:
* Returns true if the current country is a NANPA country and the national number begins with
   * the national prefix.

methods.name: private String removeNationalPrefixFromNationalNumber()
methods.comment: Returns the national prefix extracted, or an empty string if it is not present.

methods.name: private boolean attemptToExtractIdd()
methods.comment:
* Extracts IDD and plus sign to prefixBeforeNationalNumber when they are available, and places
   * the remaining input into nationalNumber.
   *
   * @return  true when accruedInputWithoutFormatting begins with the plus sign or valid IDD for
   *     defaultCountry.

methods.name: private boolean attemptToExtractCountryCallingCode()
methods.comment:
* Extracts the country calling code from the beginning of nationalNumber to
   * prefixBeforeNationalNumber when they are available, and places the remaining input into
   * nationalNumber.
   *
   * @return  true when a valid country calling code can be found.
